name: paperclip2biookf
description: Generate, query, revise, refresh, and merge BioOKF knowledge bases with Paperclip and local subscription agents.

interface.shortDescription: Build and query BioOKF knowledge bases locally.
interface.longDescription: Uses Paperclip, the BioOKF CLI, and authenticated local Codex or Claude subscriptions to generate, query, evidence-check, revise, refresh, and merge provenance-rich biomedical knowledge bases without API keys.
defaultPrompt: Build a BioOKF knowledge base from Paperclip evidence.
Chat with and trace provenance in this BioOKF base.
Review this BioOKF edge with Doctor.
